Speech.NativeText: :-) We keep bumping into each other don't we? We should do this more often!
:-) Oh hello it's you again, are you stalking me? It's totally okay if you are!
:-) You're looking good today! Don't be a stranger.
:-) Wanna go for a walk a bit later?
Eh? I hadn't noticed.
:-) I'd like that!
Um... :-) okay!
:-) Ooh, I would love that!
Let's hang out here for a bit?
:-) Sure!
:-) Sure... I brought drinks!
Hey... :-) do you wanna build a snowman?
Everything looks so peaceful under the snow blanket, doesn't it? What if I just...
{:-| Oh that's it then?
:-) Haha, that was awesome! You've got some skills!
:-) Ah thanks for playing along with me.. I guess you're more of a lover than a fighter!
{:-) It's beautiful! We did a good thing here!
{:-( Okay, bye.
:-) Hey look! Rabbit over there!
{:-) Bunnies! They're so cute!
Oh, it's a rabbit. Hungry?
Bunnies! They're so cute aren't they? The little squeals they make when they die!
:-) It's kind of beautiful isn't it?... Let's have a drink!
Okay we're gonna need a carrot and uh.. let's say, a beanie hat.
:-) Woah this is the good stuff!
:-) Heheh, are you trying to get me drunk?
:-) You know, I'm feeling a little... tipsy.
:-) You're my best friend, you know that? You're my beshtest... *hic* fwiend!
:-) Show me the way to go home! Cos I'm tired and I wanna go to bed! Eh I guess we better get to bed, huh....
:-) How about a goodbye hug?
See you later hon.
Ohh yeah that takes the edge off.
8-| You know, I don't normally do this kind of thing..
{:-| Man, I've had it with all these zombies, and people and.. and.. people that look like people, but they're actually zombies... Fuck all of them!
}:-| You want to fight? Come on then, let's have a fight! I'll take you on! I'll take you all on! Goddam.. goddam zombies and looters and shit...!
:-) You're my best... person that I met, you know that?
{:-( Someday all this is gonna be over... there's still army units out there, there are camps. They'll rescue us. I gotta *hic* believe that!
I wonder what happens if the infected eat you when you're drunk? Do they absorb the alcohol? I bet they're angry drunks... like, super aggressive.
:-) I love these warm summer nights.
So much less likely to kill you than the freezing cold winter ones.
:-) Sure... glad you brought booze!
Let's get some more drinks first.
I want something to drink.. let's get some booze first.
:-) If we're going for a walk let's bring carrots in case we see any rabbits. We could use the meat.
See if you can attract it with a carrot. Stay low, and don't make any sudden movements.
:-) That's it, let it come closer.
:-) This is adorable!
It's working.
:-) So cute! The bunny, I mean. And you of course!
{:-) You know what, let's not eat this one. It can be the one that got away.
:-) Alright I'm getting cold, let's get back. I had a great time though!
We have the hat.
:-( We don't have either of those on us.
Seen any bunnies around here? Let's check out the area, we might get lucky and catch one.
We should try to find some rabbits, for the stew.
:-) We should head back anyway. Thanks for this, I had a nice time.
:-) I love these warm summer days.
:-) So romantic!
}:-| You sure picked a weird time for it. Couldn't you have waited till the rain stopped?
:-) We have both already!
We have a carrot.
It's dark... watch out for infected.
:-) You chose a nice day for it.

Quest.NativeDescription: Go for a short walk somewhere nearby where you can be alone together.
Explore the area a little. Try not to end up in a fight.
Snowball fight! (Look directly downwards at the snowy ground to scoop snow.)
Build a snowperson. (Look directly downwards at the snowy ground to scoop snow.)
Find a hat and a carrot to make a snowman with.
